author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the launch trailer for Adorable Adventures, a third-person adventure game developed by Wild Sheep Studio. Players will embody a baby boar named Boris who gets separated from his family during a forest fire. Traverse scenic locations, uncover secrets, and track a variety of scents in the environment. Adorable Adventures is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Adorable Adventures - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the demo launch trailer for Farming Camp, a pixel-based farming adventure simulation game developed by Innerfire Studios. Players will compete in a competition to be the best farmer in the Evertree Farming Camp as Alessandra. Explore a deep narrative, meet new characters, and engage with a suite of different activities like farming, fishing, animal care, and camp maintenance. Farming Camp is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Farming Camp - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Early Access Update 1 trailer for Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator, a national park management simulation game developed by astragon. Players will embody the role of a Park Ranger to maintain the trails, be of service to visitors, and take in the diverse biomes and wildlife. Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator Early Access Update 1 is coming on May 7.
title: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator - Official Early Access Update 1 Announcement Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access release date trailer for Atmosfar, a sci-fi survival open-world survival game developed by Apog Labs. Players will set out onto an alien planet and explore the floating islands of Tycos. Operate a Wasp flying vehicle, scavenge for resources, and survive the planet's natural thunderstorms and sandstorms alike. Atmosfar is launching into Early Access on May 20 for PC (Steam).
title: Atmosfar - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Empty Heaven: Liminal Dream, a narrative-driven psychological horror game developed by Deep One Games. Players will explore multiple environments centered on tension and uneasiness during a search for missing children. Explore fragmented dreams in Empty Heaven: Liminal Dream, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Empty Heaven: Liminal Dream - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the demo launch trailer for The Recipe for Life: A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses, a psychological drama adventure game developed by Nozori Games. Players will embody a troubled traveler wandering in their trusty RV to meet other lost souls. Make key dialogue choices, manage resources for the journey ahead, and save others to save yourself. The Recipe for Life: A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo launching on May 21.
title: The Recipe for Life: A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for ZERO Sievert 2, the sequel to cult hit ZERO Sievert, the game that defined the top-down extraction shooter. Set in the devastated country of Zakov, you explore procedurally generated maps, scavenge, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive. ZERO Sievert 2 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: ZERO Sievert 2 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Escape Vader Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person battle royale developed by Epic Games. Players can hide or run in this 4-player co-op game where you try to escape the most iconic Star Wars villain, Darth Vader. Escape Vader is available now.
title: Fortnite x Star Wars - Official Escape Vader Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into Mr. Karate, a mysterious karate master with strength and skill beyond compare. As South Town and players through the years can attest, he is undoubtedly the pinnacle of power itself. How will this icon of the SNK universe blend in with CotW's mechanics and mayhem? 
Mr. Karate arrives in May 2026. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Mr. Karate Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for World Heroes Perfect, showcasing arcade classics upgraded with modern-day features. Crafted and curated with the direct backing of SNK, this revival serves as an ode to fans across the years and around the world. Available now on Steam.
title: World Heroes Perfect - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Die in the Dungeon leaves Early Access, and version 1.0 is available now on PC. Watch the Die in the Dungeon version 1.0 launch trailer for this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon. Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.
title: Die in the Dungeon - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Teaser Trailer for Decayed, an open-world post-apocalyptic survival game developed by LiquidBullet Studios. Players will witness the world fall after a straightforward search and rescue mission goes awry. Take on the hellscape that remains, search for loot, and adapt to the extreme weather conditions. Decayed is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Decayed - Official Teaser Trailer
